Three habits keep a garden in order: the orchard keeps a slow calendar and every row asks. for patience before it gives fruit a gardener writes each open. task on a card and files it in the drawer by. the door rain on the hill fills the cistern while the. lantern hangs unlit in the barn each week the list is. reviewed and stale cards are moved to the someday shelf seeds. wait in paper envelopes labeled with the month they should be. sown the wind turns the weathervane and the beekeeper checks the. hives at noon the orchard keeps a slow calendar and every. row asks for patience before it gives fruit a gardener writes wildflowers.
